rule.end_rule: the leg ends when the measured updater go test process exits; 30 s of post-exit sampling recorded, never disqualifying
rule.deciding_intervals: every 5 s interval that starts before the measured process exits
rule.foreign_cpu_excludes: kernel threads (pid 2 and children) and dockerd, containerd, containerd-shim*, docker-proxy, runc; recorded apart
rule.preflight: admission free, no foreign suite, foreign CPU 30 s average <= 0.5 cores; vmstat recorded only
